prospect.name: Erik Seman
prospect.occupation: Lawyer — co-founder and partner of his own law firm, set up at age 30; previously seven years at the Slovak branch of a US law firm
prospect.family_status: Has an eight-year-old daughter who swims competitively; married status not stated. Was not married and had no children through his twenties.
prospect.training_background: National-level junior tennis player through his teens; competed at international junior tournaments in Europe and South America aged 16 and considered a US D1 college scholarship. Also trained athletics, weights, cardio and gymnastics. Stopped at university and lost condition across ~22 years of desk work. Since then sporadic gym, running and occasional tennis in two-month bursts that never persist.
prospect.medical: No injuries, chronic pain or health conditions disclosed. Explicitly denies any: 'I have never had, like, big injuries or anything like that... Nothing I can think of, really, what would limit me.' Reports non-specific whole-body aching attributed to poor sleep during heavy work travel. NOTE: the rep asked only about injuries and movement limitations; health conditions, blood pressure, cardiac and hereditary history were never asked.

signals: Former high-level athlete explicitly wanting the former self back: 'I lost all my athletic abilities or anything'
Visible regret, twice self-deprecating: 'it feels embarrassing, kind of pathetic' and 'I'm mad at myself for allowing to do that'
Ground lost to a hard season rather than to illness — 22 years of law-firm hours: 'I was just Spending my time in the office'
Admits the decline was partly complacency about a former athletic base: 'sometimes I may have been a little bit cocky, like I don't need it'
Not a prehab_fighter — no active health event; not an optimizer — he is recovering ground, not extending an already-good position

goals.text: Feel physically better as a 45-year-old man — not aesthetics, explicitly not a six-pack
Keep up with his eight-year-old daughter swimming, cycling and hiking, and still be able to as she becomes a teenager
Still move freely at 70 without a cane
Climb the stairs to his office without being out of breath
Break the start-stop pattern and finally stay consistent
Build strength with weights specifically to protect joints as he ages
Fit training into 40-50 minutes a day around an unpredictable legal workload
Hike Gerlach (the high Tatras) without needing to stop for breath

pains.text: Trains hard for two months, feels the results, then a project comes along and it collapses entirely — 'you miss one workout, you miss two, then a few days become a week... and then you realize, oh, six months passed by'
Out of breath swimming with his eight-year-old daughter and cannot keep up with her
Fear of being physically useless to his daughter by the time she is a teenager and he is 50
Work is allowed to override everything else, and he knows it is irrational — 'once something comes along work-wise, nothing is more important, and that is just not true'
Self-tracking apps stop working because nothing external holds him to them — 'you just stop checking because something happens and, like, nobody cares really'
Out of breath climbing the stairs to his office
Poor and insufficient sleep during heavy travel or intense project periods, leaving the whole body aching
Embarrassment and self-directed anger at having let 22 years of athletic capacity go
No capacity for the three-to-four-hour training days he was once used to

evidence: Unhesitating verbal agreement immediately on the price: rep 'the full investment for that, it's 6K USD' / 'Ready to rock and roll?' — prospect 'We must. Let's do it, man.'
Payment link sent in the Zoom chat during the call: 'in the Zoom chat, I'm sending you the payment link for everything'
Onboarding call with Trevor provisionally booked for the following evening at 19:15

COUNTER-EVIDENCE: payment did NOT process. The link would not load on the prospect's machine, blocked by his corporate VPN — 'It's loading, loading, loading, but it doesn't work' and 'I have VPN and I cannot go over it because it's my computer'
COUNTER-EVIDENCE: the rep re-sent the link by a second route and it still failed, so the call ended with the deal agreed but uncollected
COUNTER-EVIDENCE: resolution was deferred to a second Zoom the same evening at 20:30 which is NOT present in this batch, so payment confirmation is unverified in the corpus
Zero price resistance, zero objections and no attempt to negotiate — the prospect volunteered 'Let's do it' before the rep had finished the close
outcome.next_step: Reconvene on the same Zoom link at 20:30 the same evening on a different (non-VPN) computer to complete the $6,000 payment; onboarding call with Trevor at 19:15 the following day.

notable.note: A textbook-easy close reached with a badly incomplete baseline. Andrew ran a genuinely strong emotional discovery — he got from 'I want to feel better' to a specific fear about a daughter at 15 — but never asked age, height, weight, health conditions, blood pressure, current training days, diet or sleep. A 45-year-old with 22 years of desk work who is winded on a flight of office stairs was sold six months of loaded ballistic kettlebell training on the strength of a single injuries question. Also of note: the pillars were presented BEFORE the commitment check, inverting the script's order, and the payment link failing to a corporate VPN is a repeatable technical failure mode worth engineering around.

quality.notes: Severe and continuous. Whole passages invert: the rep's discovery questions ('And what does actually feeling better mean to you?', 'what's your timeline on this') are repeatedly attached to Erik's label, and Erik's answers appear inside Andrew-labelled blocks. The exchange about ages at ~00:05:00 is scrambled such that 'I'm 43' and 'I'm 45 today' land on the same speaker; resolved from content — Erik is 45 (he says 'in five years, I will be 50' and 'as a 45-year-old man') and it is his birthday, Andrew is 43. Role assigned throughout from content, never from label.
